name: SCP Foundation: Iris Through the Looking Glass
source:
A normal boy in his teens and his girlfriend from school.
They discovered a strange phenomenon in the school library.

As fans of the paranormal. They decide to solve the mystery.
Trying to figure out what's going on.
They learn that this anomaly only occurs in the boy.

Is this a curse?
Or something even scarier?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1769720/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一个十几岁的普通男孩和他的学校女友。
他们在学校图书馆发现了一个奇怪的现象。

作为超自然现象的粉丝。他们决定解开这个谜团。
试图弄清楚发生了什么事。
他们了解到这种异常现象只发生在男孩身上。

这是诅咒吗？
或者更可怕的事情？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1769720/]Steam[/url]]
